topic: How we work: from your first message to project kickoff
caption:
What happens after you message a dev team? Here's how we take a project from first message to kickoff. 🚀

1️⃣ We listen: the problem, the users, the goal
2️⃣ We scope the core: what version one really needs
3️⃣ We pick the stack: web, mobile, backend, chosen to fit
4️⃣ We plan it: milestones you can see and review
5️⃣ We kick off: one team, clear next steps

No surprises, and all through our ISO-certified process. Swipe for each step. →

Have a project in mind? DM us START and tell us what you want to build.

Share this with someone planning a product. 🔁

slides.title: From first message to kickoff.
slides.sub: What happens before we write a line of code.

slides.title: We listen first.
slides.body: The problem, the users and the goal. Not a feature list yet, just what success looks like for you.

slides.title: We scope the core.
slides.body: Together we find the one core user journey and what version one really needs. The rest can wait.

slides.title: We pick the stack.
slides.body: Web, mobile, backend: proven tools chosen to fit your product and who will maintain it.

slides.title: We plan it with you.
slides.body: Clear milestones you can see and review, so you always know what's next and what's done.

slides.title: We kick off.
slides.body: One team, clear next steps, and our ISO-certified process from day one.

slides.title: Let's start with your idea.
slides.sub: Tell us what you want to build. We'll tell you how we'd approach it.
